rationale.selection_basis: Low Volatility environment, seeking lower cost entry than Straddle.
rationale.thesis: Mindset: We expect a significant move, but want to reduce upfront debit. We sacrifice some probability (need larger move) for better leverage/ROI if it hits.
rationale.leg_selection: Bought 25 Delta Call and Put (OTM). This reduces cost compared to ATM Straddle but requires a larger move to become profitable.
